scripts/lib/scraper.js.reason: canonical implementation of fetchPage()/fetchJSON() — the thing every other caller should route through

scripts/lib/url-discovery.js.reason: canonical shared serpQuery() lib (Scraping v2 Sprint 1 T7) — Google SERP is a different capability than page-content fetch, not covered by fetchPage()

scripts/lib/site-search-discovery.js.reason: canonical outlet-site-search lib — searches an outlet's own search endpoint, a different capability than generic page fetch; has its own documented SB fallback tier

scripts/lib/reddit-api.js.reason: Reddit JSON API accessed via provider-as-proxy (documented adaptive rate-limit design in file header) — not page-content scraping, fetchPage() doesn't fit this shape

scripts/probe-scrapingdog-billing.js.reason: explicit Scrapingdog billing/credit probe tool — needs the raw provider response, not fetchPage()'s abstracted fallback chain

scripts/scrapingdog-bakeoff.js.reason: explicit provider bake-off/comparison eval tool — by design calls providers directly to compare them

scripts/check-cookie-health.js.reason: diagnostic tool validating cookie freshness PER PROVIDER — needs the raw per-provider response, not fetchPage()'s abstracted fallback/verification chain

scripts/lib/browserbase-session.js.reason: canonical Browserbase session-create chokepoint (task #752) — the thing every caller routes through for attribution + userMetadata

scripts/lib/browserbase-live-usage.js.reason: read-only GET against /v1/sessions (live session-count check) — same endpoint as session-create but a different HTTP method/capability; not a content fetch

scripts/lib/provider-billing.js.reason: the one reader of provider billing APIs (Scraping v2 Sprint 0) — its Browserbase call is a read-only session-count-for-day GET, not a session create

scripts/health-check.js.reason: daily health check's Browserbase call is GET /v1/projects/{id}/usage — a credit/usage read, the same capability the detector intentionally exempts for BD/SB/SD billing endpoints; creates no session and spends nothing

scripts/newspapers-browserbase-login.js.reason: interactive one-time newspapers.com login tool; its session CREATE now routes through createBbSession() (task #752), and its remaining raw /v1 calls are context create + session debug/release — per-session operations with no chokepoint equivalent

scripts/evaluate-brightdata-serp.js.reason: explicit provider bake-off/comparison eval tool (ScrapingBee vs Bright Data SERP quality) — by design calls both SERP endpoints directly to compare raw results, same category as scrapingdog-bakeoff.js
